issue_request: FHIR-11252 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for the 2016 September ballot introduction. It requested changing the statement that the second FHIR Standard for Trial Use was published in October, 2016 so that it said October, 2015.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 917c617bd6cf0d2374bb3066af800a000e7ee4df, labeled '#11252 - fix typo' and SVN revision 10329, changed source/ballot-intro.html from October, 2016 to October, 2015. This matches the Jira comment that recorded svn revision 10329.
additional_context: The current checkout still builds source/ballot-intro.html via publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml, but the file is now the active R6 ballot introduction and does not contain the DSTU2/STU3 year sentence. A curl check of https://hl7.org/fhir/2016sep/ballot-intro.html still found the archived rendered page showing October, 2016; that is an archived publication surface, not current build source to edit in this reconciliation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source file was edited because the current source has no occurrence of the incorrect historical sentence and changing the active R6 ballot introduction would not fix the archived 2016sep publication page.
